descriptionText: Workflows should reference secrets individually rather than provisioning the entire secrets context. Patterns like toJSON(secrets) or dynamic secret indexing (e.g., secrets[variable]) expose all repository secrets to the workflow runner at once, significantly expanding the attack surface. If an attacker compromises the workflow or runner, they gain access to all secrets rather than just the ones explicitly needed. Dynamic indexing with non-literal keys (like secrets[format('PAT_%s', matrix.env)]) also provisions multiple secrets unnecessarily. Instead, reference each required secret explicitly by its literal name (e.g., secrets.MY_SECRET).
